Name: Jezreel in Judah
ModernLocation: Unknown; in the hill country of Judah
Description: A town in Judah's hill country, named only in the allotment list. It is distinct from Jezreel in Issachar, the city of the Jezreel valley.
BiblicalSignificance: Jezreel in Judah is a hill town of the allotment, not the valley city of Issachar.
